authority: #K2-469 appendix B (every escape-planner parameter must cite REF-CASE-LIBRARY sec.E; anything uncited is named 'maintain current value' with a one-time reason, sec.20.5) + #K2-472 sec.3.4 (fix the gauge: true-shape pad model, escape must leave the pad, pin the bound literal, close the fixture on every layer, rerun the precheck).

dirs_8_incl_45deg.citation: REF-CASE-LIBRARY sec.E: industry fanout/escape passes (KiCad fanout, FreeRouting, commercial tools) route pin escapes at 45 degrees, not only orthogonally; the book puts the 45-degree practice in the same entry that names the in-repo mechanism anchors.

dogleg_two_segments.value: two segments: seg1 <= 5 steps (<=0.5mm), turn +/-45 deg, seg2 <= 5 steps (<=0.5mm)
dogleg_two_segments.citation: REF-CASE-LIBRARY sec.E: the same industry practice - dense fields are escaped with a dogleg/offset rather than one straight leg; the limits are kept deliberately SHORT (0.5mm each) so the corridor stays inside the pad neighbourhood, which is what a fanout/escape pass does.
dogleg_two_segments.one_time_note: the exact split (5/5) is a first implementation choice with no product citation for the split itself; it is declared here rather than presented as product-derived. It is conservative (shorter legs = less freedom consumed) and bounded.

max_escape_len_2p0mm.citation: NONE - inherited from the supervisor prescription (#K2-467 sec.2.1).
max_escape_len_2p0mm.one_time_reason: MAINTAIN CURRENT VALUE: it was the commissioning parameter and it has not been shown to be the binding cause (the census shows the refusals come from obstacles within ~1mm, not from the 2.0mm cut-off). Changing it before the scheme-layer decision would be ad-hoc tuning (sec.20.5).
max_escape_len_2p0mm.supervisor_self_correction: M-SUP-PRESCRIPTION-UNGROUNDED +1 (the value was prescribed without product grounding).

step_0p1mm.citation: NONE - inherited from the same prescription.
step_0p1mm.one_time_reason: MAINTAIN CURRENT VALUE: consistent with the maze fine step (FINE_STEP=0.10) already in the register, so it is at least coherent with the engine; changing it is a relaxation nobody asked for.

clear_0p30mm.citation: PARTIAL: the chain acceptance caliber is floor 0.20 (wrapper --floor) plus the 0.10 trace half-width, i.e. 0.30 is DERIVED from the registered acceptance model rather than invented - see the R1434-era notes on the caliber divergence (M-ENG-CLEARANCE-MODEL-DIVERGENCE).
clear_0p30mm.one_time_reason: MAINTAIN CURRENT VALUE: it equals acceptance floor + own half-width, which is the strictest coherent reading of the register.

local_filter_radius_3p5mm.citation: NONE - implementation detail (a performance bound, not a geometry rule).
local_filter_radius_3p5mm.one_time_reason: MAINTAIN CURRENT VALUE: it is >= max_escape_len + dogleg reach, so it cannot change any decision; it exists only to honour the owner red line (no CPU spike).

verdict_ge_the_unconnected_ends_only.value: escape assets are required for UNCONNECTED endpoints only; connected ends PASS-by-route
verdict_ge_the_unconnected_ends_only.citation: #K2-468 sec.3.2 (the gate-scope self-correction) + the in-repo arithmetic: C1=2 has been stable for many windows with the same two named residuals, and the census matched 2 refusals to those 2 ends exactly.

pad_shape_model.value: obstacles: each pad is a CAPSULE along its long axis (segment half-length (max-min)/2, hw = min(size)/2); a square pad degenerates to a point with hw = min/2
pad_shape_model.citation: REF-CASE-LIBRARY sec.E + IPC-7351 land patterns: pads are rounded rectangles; the long-axis capsule is the standard faithful representation of their copper extent.
pad_shape_model.one_time_note: a rectangular land is modelled by its long-axis capsule: the SHORT-axis extent is exact (that is the binding dimension at pin pitch); the long-axis ENDS are rounded, a small declared under-estimate. This replaces the isotropic max(size)/2 disc (R1498) which over-sized a 0.300x1.475 pad by 4.92x in the short direction and MANUFACTURED the two refusals (R1520).
pad_shape_model.provenance_of_the_correction: R1520 (decisive read: same board, same criterion, only the pad model changed => go False -> True)

escape_must_leave_the_pad.value: a candidate escape is accepted only if its ENDPOINT lies OUTSIDE the pad rect (pad_rect = cx,cy,hx,hy[,rot_deg])
escape_must_leave_the_pad.one_time_reason: MAINTAIN: without it, a 0.1mm leg that never leaves the pad's own copper is counted as an asset - a stub, not an escape. The endpoint is the maze's start cell, which is exactly the R1430 no-free-start-node lesion.

vias_are_obstacles.value: a via contributes an obstacle (point + via_diameter/2) on EVERY copper layer of its layer span
vias_are_obstacles.citation: R1358 lesson + tests/test_eda_eng.py::test_C448 (a clearance check MUST enumerate every layer a via covers) - in-repo doctrine.
vias_are_obstacles.one_time_note: the R1498/R1506 harness SKIPPED vias entirely; v2 includes them (46 vias on the stitched board). Declared change.

via_escape_branch.citation: #K2-472 sec.3.2 (supervisor self-correction), on the strength of R1520 finding 1.
via_escape_branch.one_time_reason: PROOF OF SUBSUMPTION: _leg_clear needs clear+hw; a via disc needs clear+via_r+hw (strictly larger) and, for r>0, also a clear in-plane prefix. If the in-plane ladder refuses, the k=1 leg is blocked in EVERY direction => an obstacle lies within 0.25+hw of the pad centre => the r=0 via (needs 0.475+hw) is blocked; and for r>=step that obstacle lies within 0.15+hw of a sub-segment of the required prefix => the r>0 candidate is skipped. So the branch can never flip a refusal - landing it would be false completeness.

cands_max_560.value: 560 candidates per pad = 8 dirs x 20 steps (160) + 8 x 5 x 2 x 5 dogleg (400); pinned as a literal in code (CANDS_MAX_LITERAL) and asserted as a literal in the test
cands_max_560.citation: #K2-472 sec.3.4(3): the literal must be re-derived and pinned; binding it to the symbol under test makes the owner-bound regression a tautology (the R1516 failure).
cands_max_560.one_time_note: the via term (960) recorded during R1514/R1516 is GONE with the closed branch - 560 is again the complete bound.
